hook: A passenger train struck a stationary delivery van at 71 mph.

sections.voiceover: A passenger train struck a stationary delivery van at 71 mph.
On 13 July 2025, a train ran from Ramsgate to London Victoria. Why did the van stop at 12:42 on the Bax user-worked crossing in Kent?
But the Rail Accident Investigation Branch Report 12/2026 reveals how the Bax level crossing failed.
Investigators filled 58 pages with findings about the collision that occurred in Kent. This digital file size for the 58 pages reached 18.1 MB.
Report 12/2026 finally documents the 71 mph collision at the Bax crossing.
